title: HealthEquity Reports First Quarter Ended April 30, 2026 Financial Results; Raises Guidance
summary: Increases Repurchase Program by $1.0 Billion Highlights of the first quarter include: Net income increased 29% to $69.4 million, and net income margin increased to 20% from 16% last year. Adjusted EBITDA increased 17% to $164.5 million, and Adjusted EBITDA margin increased to 46% from 42% last
